title: Wso2am: Improper permission check in ZooKeeper AdminServer lets authorized clients to run snapshot and restore command…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package involves an improper permission check in the ZooKeeper AdminServer component. This flaw allows authorized clients to execute snapshot and restore commands without having sufficient permissions. The issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
